description: This file defines the LeaveManager class responsible for managing leave data operations such as create, update, delete, and retrieval of leave entries within an Android application. It handles local persistence using SharedPreferences and maintains in-memory LiveData for reactive data updates.

classes.name: LeaveManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing leave entries, providing create, update, delete, and retrieval functionalities, with local persistence and reactive LiveData updates.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides singleton instance of LeaveManager, ensuring thread-safe initialization.

methods.name: createLeave
methods.description: Creates a new leave entry, adds it to the list, sorts, and persists.

methods.name: updateLeave
methods.description: Updates an existing leave identified by ID, sorts, and saves.

methods.name: deleteLeave
methods.description: Removes a leave entry by ID and updates storage.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave by ID.

methods.name: getLeavesForDate
methods.description: Returns all leaves occurring on a specified date.

methods.name: loadLeaves
methods.description: Loads leave data from SharedPreferences, parsing JSON into Leave objects.

methods.name: saveLeaves
methods.description: Serializes current leave list into JSON and saves to SharedPreferences.
